title: Compare two emitted photons
statement:
Which emission has the higher frequency, hydrogen 4→2 or 4→3?

[_]{a}

explanations: This has the larger energy drop.
The final level affects the gap.

hints: Larger energy gap means larger frequency.
solution: The initial level is shared. n=2 is lower than n=3. Larger energy gap means larger frequency. This has the larger energy drop.
